subject.title: typedocs-only PR to help others avoid kubernetes OOM-kills

question: Should OpenClaw ship a fixed `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536` heap cap in the shared Kubernetes manifest, or keep the cap as optional operator guidance?
rationale: The choice affects every user who copies or updates the sample Kubernetes manifest, and automation cannot decide the permanent default without maintainer intent.

options.title: Ship after correction and proof
options.body: Keep the fixed manifest cap only after correcting the Node/cgroup wording and adding redacted Kubernetes proof for the reported OOM behavior.

options.title: Make it optional guidance
options.body: Move the heap cap to docs or an overlay so operators opt in and tune it alongside their memory limit.

options.title: Wait for stronger reproduction
options.body: Hold the PR until a maintainer or contributor provides a reproducible Kubernetes workload and before/after evidence.

recommendation.title: Ship after correction and proof
recommendation.body: Keep the fixed manifest cap only after correcting the Node/cgroup wording and adding redacted Kubernetes proof for the reported OOM behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Kubernetes install surface and are the clearest routing owner for the sample manifest default.
